{{Quote|What's the "Free Droid Enclave"?''"<br />"''It's a haven for sentient, organic-hating droids. I can't believe my Teecee joined them.|A spacer and [[Carina]]|<ref name="TOR:MF">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Memory Flush|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>}}
The '''Free Droid Enclave''' was established in the [[Network Security District]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was a habitat of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] who for various reasons have broken off from their masters and came to live on their own, servants to no one but themselves.<ref name="TOR:MF" />
